source.article: Bokang Wang, Tanglong Bai, Weide Wang, Hongti Zhang, Mechanical Properties of Silicon Nitride in Different Morphologies: In Situ Experimental Analysis of Bulk and Whisker Structures, Materials 17(18), 4549 (2024).

admitted_scope.representation: Table 1 per-whisker reported values. Each property sample_count is 1 for that individual whisker; group n=4 is source context, not a group mean. The listed Y2O3 and MgSiN2 are source group/aid labels, not asserted retained whisker composition.

identity_review.result: No duplicate Wang DOI, matching whisker states, or matching properties were found in the local inorganic catalog before admission.
identity_review.difference: Distinct Si3N4-Al2O3-Y2O3 bulk input formulation with density only; not the individual whisker populations.

limitations: Article says fracture stress is calculated from fracture load but the inspected method text does not specify the exact cross-sectional area/stress formula.
The article does not report per-whisker uncertainty or raw force-displacement curves for independent curve-level recomputation.
Young's modulus is author-calculated as fracture stress divided by fracture strain; this calculation basis is preserved.
No temperature or SEM environment pressure is reported for these observations.
Publisher PDF endpoint denied access; official publisher full-text HTML was inspected. No source PDF or raw data asset is bundled.
These sample-level facts are not bulk ceramic, product-grade, or universal Si3N4 reference properties.
